deferred_xm.detail: Recipient-active check (RULE-NOTIF-007). SEC exposes no crossmodule interface. Implemented NOTIF-owned port RecipientStatusReader with a DefaultRecipientStatusReader stub returning true. Marked // TODO: XM-NOTIF-001 DEFERRED.
deferred_xm.resolution: Replace stub with SEC crossmodule UserAccount status reader when SEC exposes one.
deferred_xm.runtime_verdict: DEFERRED, NOT READY (INT-R gate, 2026-09-05). INT-R.md's 'READY ✓' is aspirational; reality verified: no src/main/java/com/erp/security/crossmodule/ package exists, so the recipient-active check runs against DefaultRecipientStatusReader which always returns true. Non-blocking for NOTIF's own runtime — fallback treats the recipient as active. Unblock condition: SEC must expose a crossmodule UserAccount-status reader, then replace DefaultRecipientStatusReader with it.

deferred_xm.detail: attachmentFileId validation via FILE FileService. FILE module does not exist. attachmentFileId accepted as-is; validation site marked // TODO: XM-NOTIF-002 DEFERRED in NotificationTemplateService.create and DispatchService.dispatch.
deferred_xm.resolution: Validate attachmentFileId via FILE FileService when FILE module is built.
deferred_xm.runtime_verdict: DEFERRED, NOT READY (INT-R gate, 2026-09-05). Non-blocking for NOTIF's own runtime — fallback omits/accepts the attachment (nullable). Unblock condition: build the FILE module, then wire FileService validation of attachmentFileId at the marked sites.

api_doc_gaps.detail: Plan/SRS specified GET-with-query for log query (API-NOTIF-002) and list/search of templates/channels. Implemented as POST /search with a request body.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: Binding build-create-controller A.6.6 forbids GET-search; the shared search contract is POST-body-only. Same resolution MDM applied for API-MDM-002/007. Skill outranks plan.

api_doc_gaps.detail: Plan/DB-script marked XM-NOTIF-001 (recipient-active via SEC) READY, but SEC has no crossmodule surface to read UserAccount status.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: Deferred with a NOTIF-owned RecipientStatusReader port + stub returning true (RULE-NOTIF-007 assumes active). Replace when SEC exposes a crossmodule reader.

api_doc_gaps.detail: Plan/DB-script marked XM-NOTIF-002 (attachmentFileId via FILE FileService) READY, but the FILE module does not exist.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: Deferred; attachmentFileId accepted without validation, site marked with a TODO. Replace when FILE is built.

api_doc_gaps.detail: Plan/SRS specified an in-process CU NotificationEvent listener as the dispatch trigger. Implemented a NOTIF crossmodule interface (NotificationDispatchApi + DispatchCommand) instead; other modules call it rather than NOTIF listening to their internal events.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: build-create-service forbids listening to another module's internal event type (and CU NotificationEvent does not exist). Skill outranks plan.

api_doc_gaps.detail: Plan specified HTTP 202 for dispatch. Implemented returns HTTP 200.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: The shared ServiceResult/Status taxonomy + OperationCode express only 200/201, and common is out of scope for this sub to modify. Returned Status.SUCCESS (200); revisit if an ACCEPTED status is added to the shared taxonomy.

api_doc_gaps.detail: SVC-API declared the NOTIF constants with SINGULAR nouns (PERM_NOTIF_TEMPLATE_*, PERM_NOTIF_CHANNEL_*) while the page_codes are PLURAL (NOTIF_TEMPLATES/NOTIF_CHANNELS); runtime-generated + V7-seeded codes are PLURAL (PERM_<PAGE_CODE>_<TYPE>), so every template/channel endpoint would have 403'd.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: RESOLVED. Renamed the 8 constants and their string VALUES to the PLURAL page-code-derived form (PERM_NOTIF_TEMPLATES_*, PERM_NOTIF_CHANNELS_*) and updated all @PreAuthorize refs in NotificationTemplateService/NotificationChannelConfigService; V7 seeds PERMISSION_CODE identical to these constants. PERM_NOTIF_LOG_VIEW already matched. Compile passes; grep for old singular names returns nothing.

api_doc_gaps.detail: SVC-API gated dispatch with @PreAuthorize hasAuthority(PERM_NOTIF_DISPATCH), but dispatch (API-NOTIF-001, RULE-NOTIF-005) is behind the Security filter with no management screen and SEC_PERMISSION.PAGE_FK is NOT NULL — so no PERM_NOTIF_DISPATCH row can be seeded, meaning the gate would always deny.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: RESOLVED. Re-gated dispatch to @PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()") (any authenticated principal, matching 'behind the Security filter'); removed the unused PERM_NOTIF_DISPATCH constant and dropped its crossmodule javadoc references; no dispatch permission is seeded in V7. Programmatic/event-driven dispatch with no principal (internal trusted-caller pattern) is a future concern — the XM/event triggers are DEFERRED, so no principal-less caller exists yet.
